ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have enjoyed Christmas music, but I am looking for everyday listening right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blown Away; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: This fits the country side of my listening suggested by 747 and Golden.
ItemID: NA; Title: PTXmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would save this for a time when I want Christmas music.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lifer; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not recognize enough here to expect a close match to my current interests.
ItemID: NA; Title: Home for Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The seasonal theme does not suit what I want to hear this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Musical Affair; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I already listened to the live Japan release, so exploring this recording feels like a strong fit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Summer Forever; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in orchestral music and expressive vocals than a summer-themed selection today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Family Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My past Christmas listening does not mean I want another holiday album right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: To Be Loved; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its vocal standards style fits my interest in Stages and melodic vocal albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Nostalgia Ltd. Ed Deluxe; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar standards appeal to me, but I would choose A Musical Affair first this time.
